prompt: A single simple line icon of how software is built, centred in the square frame: one wrench, an open-end spanner drawn in outline, lying diagonally from the lower left to the upper right with its open U-shaped jaw at the upper right end; crossing over the middle of its handle, one large chevron made of two straight strokes of equal length that meet in a sharp point on the left, like an arrowhead pointing left, a code angle bracket drawn as a plain geometric shape.
